nav.title: Idhenisi loQhagamshelwano le-AI
nav.subtitle: Inkonzo yokuzicela ngeelwimi ezahlukeneyo nokuhanjiswa okulawulwayo kumntu.

customer.title: Qalisa ingxoxo
customer.consentText: Ndiyavuma ukuba lo mxholo uqhutyaniswa ngumthengisi we-AI olungeleleniweyo. Iincwadi ziguqulwa phambi kokugcinwa.
customer.setupHint: Ayifumaneki de igosa linike isitshixo sokhuseleko nomthengisi we-AI.
customer.chatEmpty: Imilayezo yakho iza kuvela apha. Iintshukumo ze-AI ziziphakamiso kuphela; akukho kokubhatala, utshintsho kwe-akhawunti, ukubuyisela okanye ukuthumela okwenziwayo.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Ilizwi lesikhangeli lisasazwa kumboneleli olungiselelweyo; i-OpsCore ayibhengezi ukuba igcina isandi esingaqhubekekanga.
customer.voiceRequirement: Ilizwi lesikhangeli ludinga i-HTTPS (okanye i-localhost), imikrofoni, imvume, imodeli ye-Realtime elungiselelweyo nesitshixo somboneleli. Asisiso ibhulorho yefowuni ye-PSTN/SIP.

queue.title: Ulandelelwano lokunyuswa
queue.description: Apha kubonakala iingxoxo zengozi ephezulu, ezingatyoliweyo okanye ekubizwa umntu. Into kulandelelwano ithetha ukucelwa, hayi ukudibeneyo.
queue.empty: Akukho kuphanjiswa komntu okusebenzayo kwalo mbandakanyo.
queue.replyStorageNote: Iimpendulo zabantu ziyahlanganiswa xa zigcinwa kwaye ziyabonakala kwikopi yencoko.

boundaries.title: Iidangele zokusebenza
boundaries.automateBody: Impendulo yokuqala yezilimi ezininzi, ukucacisa, ukwahlula inhloso nengozi, ukugcina iincwadi ngekhuseleko, ukudala amalandelwano nokwabiwa we-ejenti.
boundaries.humanBody: Isicelo somntu esicace gca, ukholo lwasezantsi, ingozi ephezulu okanye eyona injongo, umgaqo ongatholakaliyo, icala elingatyoliwanga, isikhalazo sobufihlo/ukhuseleko okanye isenzo esingaqinisekanga.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Ukuqhagamshelwa kwe-PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/imeyile, ibhulorho yefowuni ebomvu, ukuqinisekiswa kwesaziso se-CRM kunye nabandakanya ubulungisa bolwimi kufuna isiqhagamshelwi somthengisi, iinkcukacha kunye novavanyo lwamkelo.

messages.qualificationNotice: Ayikho ilwimi elityikitywe ukwenza into ngaphambi kokuba kuvavanywa uvavanyo lwetekisi, lwe-ASR, lwe-TTS, lwegama kanye nokunyuswa.
messages.configOk: Ukulungiselela kukhona. Ukuqhagamshelwa komthengisi nobulumko bolwimi kusafuna uvavanyo lwamkelo olwenziwayo.
messages.conversationCreated: Ingxoxo ekhuselekileyo yenzekile. Ubuhle bolwimi akubheniswa ukwenza into.
messages.handoffQueued: Ukuphanjiselwa komntu kulandelwe ({reason}). Lo mbuzo wolandelwano, ukuqhagamshelwa okusemthethweni hayi.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Impendulo ye-AI ayiphelelanga. Akukho senzo senziweyo. Ungacela i-ejenti yomntu.
messages.apiUnavailable: I-API ye-Contact Center ayikwazanga ukulayishwa. Ngena kwikhonsoli ye-OpsCore, uze uyilayishe kwakhona eli phepha.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Ukudlulisela kumntu kufakwe kumgca ({reason}). Umgca awubonisi ukuba ummeli uqhagamshelwe.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Ukudlulisela kumntu kufakwe kumgca. Iseshoni ye-AI yesikhangeli iyema; ukudlulisela ifowuni ngqo akulungiselelwanga.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Umboneleli wexesha lokwenyani uxele impazamo. Yima iseshoni yelizwi uze uzame kwakhona emva kokuhlola ulungiselelo lomboneleli.
messages.voiceActive: Iseshoni yelizwi iyasebenza. Cofa “Cela i-ejenti yomntu” nangaliphi na ixesha; oku kwenza into emgceni, hayi ukudlulisela kwe-PSTN.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Imvume iyafuneka ngaphambi kokuba incoko iqale.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Esi sikhangeli asixhasi ilizwi lexesha lokwenyani.
